data.name: Sosna Metelyk
data.description: Sosna Metelyk is an unfunded American-Ukrainian early-stage climate hardware startup founded in 2023, incorporated in California with operations in Cherkasy, Ukraine. It is developing a conceptual passive direct-air-capture pod with embedded solar alongside several unrelated hardware ideas, and self-reports TRL 4 R&D with no commercial deliveries or registry issuances. Founder Oksana Gal remains publicly active, but the company has no funding, no team build-out, and no demonstrated hardware.
